jp_a6m5a_1944.source: Model52 family museum: 230mph cruise, 3090ft/min climb, 38520ft ceiling. Tamiya61103: 565km/h; Ko introduced Feb1944. Internal518L*0.72kg/L approximate. Sea-level speed, acceleration, bank/roll/pitch, drag and burn are explicit simulation approximations, not balance values. No external tank.

spatial.source: New generic point-mass/control operating estimates, not historical structural limits or balance changes. Load/stall/energy relationships: FAA AFH ch4/ch5 and NASA Forces in a Climb. Existing subtype max speed, sustained climb, fuel and armament unchanged. No full aerodynamic polar, alpha, spin or pilot physiology. Brief negative/unloaded lift down to -0.35g and a 5s kinetic reserve horizon are generic safety/control estimates, not certified negative-g fuel/structural capability.
spatial.induced_drag_source: Same finite-wing incremental induced-drag approximation as F6F. Original validated A6M5a span11m and reference mass2740kg unchanged. Oswald e=0.8 is a generic operating estimate; the formula uses mass/span and density, no fabricated measured drag polar.

us_f6f5_1944.source: CAF F6F5 museum aircraft: over380mph, R2800-10W. US Navy AN01-85FB-1 AppendixII platesIII A/B show altitude/power/weight dependence, printedp83 gives145kt CAS long-range schedule. This game uses approximate175.24m/s envelope at7000m and89.4m/s mission cruise, not a digitized handbook curve. Climb17.8m/s/ceiling11370m are subtype reference approximations; 250USgal capacity reference*0.72kg/L. No WEP heat/time model. Acceleration, bank/roll/pitch, drag and burn are explicit simulation approximations.

spatial.source: New generic point-mass/control operating estimates, not historical structural limits or balance changes. Load/stall/energy relationships: FAA AFH ch4/ch5 and NASA Forces in a Climb. Existing subtype max speed, sustained climb, fuel and armament unchanged. No full aerodynamic polar, alpha, spin or pilot physiology. spatial.aileron_source: US Navy AN01-85FB-1 printed p29 and p34: use conservative 260kt IAS full-aileron boundary, rolling load <=+5g. 1947 manual includes later changes, not a digitized 1944 F6F-5 roll curve. Original 60deg/s remains a conservative game estimate, not increased; finite roll acceleration120deg/s² is an operating approximation.
spatial.induced_drag_source: F6F-5 wing334ft², span42ft10in: US DoD/Navy Washington submerged naval aircraft report1996 (denix.osd.mil). Reference mass5650kg unchanged. Incremental induced drag k*L²/(q*S); k=1/(pi*e*AR), e=0.8 explicitly estimated. Does not claim a complete measured F6F-5 drag polar.

us_sb2c4_1944.source: Independent clean-flight operating approximation. Reference envelope 295mph class/29100ft. Mission cruise80m/s, mass6500kg, fuel850kg, climb9.14m/s, sea-level118m/s, stall/control/burn/drag values provisional estimates, not a digitized SB2C-4 handbook or historic maximum maneuver claims. No bomb load; not F6F data. Reference: NHHC DANAS vol1 appendices, existing SB2C reference card.
